About this home

A large backyard, oversized detached shop, and RV/boat parking make this Broomfield home stand out from the start. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the Lac Amora neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers 1,827 square feet of functional living space with an incredible outdoor setup that's getting harder to find. The interior offers a practical layout with comfortable everyday living spaces, while the true highlight of the property is the expansive backyard. Enjoy a large grass area, garden space, mature fruit trees, covered patio, storage building, and plenty of room to create the outdoor space that fits your lifestyle. The oversized detached rear garage/shop provides valuable flexibility for additional parking, hobbies, projects, or storage, with added convenience from RV and boat parking. Additional features include a lawn sprinkler system, city water and sewer, baseboard heat, and carpet and roof updates from 2012 with hail-impact resistant shingles. Located in an established Broomfield neighborhood with convenient access to both Denver and Boulder, this home offers a rare combination of outdoor space, storage, and flexibility. If you've been searching for a property where the backyard and detached shop are just as important as the home itself, this one is worth seeing.

About Lac Amora 
Lac Amora, located between US-36 and W 120th Ave, is a suburban and residential Broomfield neighborhood with a lake-centered greenbelt and winding cul-de-sacs. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Lac Amora pond and its looping paths, where walkers and cyclists trace the waterline under mature trees. Housing leans toward mid-century and late-20th-century single-family homes with broad lawns and attached garages, giving streets a calm, open feel. Lac Amora Park and nearby open-space corridors set the daily rhythm with courts, play areas, and long, flat routes for laps. For a local night out, community staples such as The Burns Pub & Restaurant, 4 Noses Brewing Company, and the Broomfield Auditorium anchor nearby gathering spots. The setting reads as quietly outdoorsy, with mountain views appearing between rooftops on clear days.
